verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents official libraries per language, calling them 'the easiest way to integrate', and an async send endpoint, and it markets setup 'in minutes'. Nothing in the pack shows a copy-paste-complete quickstart or that required setup (e.g., domain verification, API key creation) is surfaced up front. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual step-by-step quickstart per language, disclosure of required setup steps such as sending-domain verification, and hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-email.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first delivered email in minutes — the quickstart is copy-paste complete for my language and doesn't hide required setup

citations.quote: MailerSend supports this list of official libraries for your favorite programming language. This is the easiest way to integrate MailerSend with your application.
Transactional email, WhatsApp and SMS you can set up in minutes and deliver in seconds.
This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
